title: Application server exploitation containment and remediation
implementation_steps: Confirm affected application, server, environment, and exposure path.
Preserve relevant logs, alerts, source URLs, and forensic evidence.
Contain the affected application or server using approved isolation controls.
Identify exploited service, vulnerable version, or exposed integration.
Apply approved patch, configuration correction, or compensating control.
Rotate credentials, API tokens, or secrets that may have been exposed.
Monitor for repeated exploit attempts or persistence indicators.
rollback_steps: Restore previous known-good application configuration if the fix causes instability.
Keep containment controls active until a security approver confirms rollback is safe.
validation_steps: Confirm vulnerable service or exposed path is no longer exploitable.
Confirm no new exploit attempts are succeeding.
Confirm affected service health is stable.
Confirm credential rotation or access revocation is complete where required.

title: Endpoint compromise containment and recovery
implementation_steps: Confirm affected endpoint, user, location, and compromise indicators.
Preserve forensic evidence and relevant endpoint telemetry.
Isolate the endpoint from the network using approved controls.
Reset affected user credentials and revoke suspicious sessions.
Remove malware or reimage endpoint according to endpoint response policy.
Review related account activity for lateral movement.
Return endpoint to service only after clean validation evidence is attached.
rollback_steps: Do not reconnect endpoint if validation fails.
Escalate to Cyber Incident Response Team if lateral movement indicators are found.
validation_steps: Confirm no new endpoint alerts are active.

title: Data exfiltration or breach claim triage
implementation_steps: Confirm whether the breach or exfiltration claim relates to the organisation.
Preserve source URLs, leak references, affected asset details, and available evidence.
Identify the likely access path and affected data types.
Contain exposed systems, accounts, integrations, or storage locations.
Rotate credentials or revoke tokens that may have been exposed.
Prepare legal and communications review package.
Monitor for additional leak indicators or repeated access attempts.
rollback_steps: Do not close containment until legal/security review confirms exposure scope.
Escalate if new leaked data or additional affected systems are found.
validation_steps: Confirm affected data scope is documented.
Confirm exposed access path is closed.
Confirm credential or token rotation is complete where required.
Confirm legal/comms evidence package is attached.
